title: Preflight Attenuation Index & Rollout Decision Matrix
description: A lightweight KPI tracker that quantifies the product/infra ability to absorb traffic shocks (the 'attenuation index') and provides a deterministic decision matrix for phase progression, throttle points, and staffing/contingency actions during rollout.
objectives: Define measurable acceptance thresholds by metric for green/yellow/red rollout states
Map thresholds to concrete operational actions and owner assignments
Provide a single-pane decision matrix for go/no-go at each traffic milestone
Capture staffing trigger rules and immediate contingency runbook steps
kpi_thresholds: P99 latency (api generation): baseline 180ms, green <=250ms, yellow 250-400ms, red >400ms (1m window)
Error rate (user-facing 4xx/5xx): baseline 0.12%, green <=0.5%, yellow 0.5-1.5%, red >1.5% (5m window)
Model-quality regressions (eval pass rate): baseline 98%, green >=97%, yellow 94-97%, red <94% (batch eval daily)
Throughput (tokens/s per cluster): baseline 85k, green >=70k, yellow 50-70k, red <50k (1m rolling)
GPU utilization (avg across pool): baseline 62%, green <=80%, yellow 80-92%, red >92% (5m window)
Cost per 1k tokens served: baseline $0.42, green <=$0.60, yellow $0.60-$0.90, red >$0.90 (billing period)
Prefix KV cache hit rate: baseline 22%, green >=20%, yellow 12-20%, red <12% (1m window)
Fallback success rate (when fallback model used): baseline 99%, green >=98%, yellow 95-98%, red <95% (10m window)
milestones: Phase 0 - internal beta: 100 rps sustained, safety checks passing, shadow traffic only
Phase 1 - alpha: 500 rps, 1% of production OA traffic, canary cohort 1% users
Phase 2 - staged roll: 2k rps, 5% traffic, canary cohort expanded to 10%
Phase 3 - ramp: 10k rps, 50% traffic, verify autoscale and SLOs
Phase 4 - global launch: full traffic, cross-region failover tested
rollout_decision_matrix: If all KPIs green for 30m at milestone -> proceed to next phase
If any KPI in yellow for >15m -> hold progression and run mitigation steps; engage owners
If >1 KPI red or any single critical KPI red (latency or error rate) -> rollback to previous stable phase and trigger incident protocol
If cost per 1k tokens moves into red but latency and quality remain green -> enable cost-mitigation band (quantize model variant + batching) and reassess for 60m
If model-quality regression yellow -> pause feature flags impacting prompts and run fast evaluation prompt set; only proceed when quality back to green
staffing_triggers: Standby Oncall SRE: any single yellow KPI sustained for 10m
Paging SRE + Infra Lead: any red latency or red error rate
Product Ops comms lead: enter yellow state for customer-visible metrics
Model Lead + Applied ML: model-quality yellow for >1h or any model-quality red
Customer Success escalation: customer-impacting errors >0.2% for a single tenant
contingency_runbook: Severity Yellow - immediate actions: enable additional autoscaling headroom, increase batching window by 10-25%, enable heavier KV prefix caching; announce in #launch-ops

Severity Red - immediate actions: divert a portion of traffic to fallback model variant, throttle new sessions, initiate rollback script to previous model version, open incident channel and run incident checklist
Cost surge action: switch to cheaper quantized variant for non-critical routes, apply per-route token limit, schedule cost postmortem
Quality regression action: switch traffic to verified model snapshot, mute risky prompt augmentations, run focused eval harness and block rollout until resolved
Cross-region failover: shift 30% traffic to secondary region if primary region GPU pool saturates above 95% for >10m
acceptance_criteria_for_go_live: All green KPIs for 30m at Phase 3 after staged roll
Fallback path validated with >=98% success in synthetic checks
Incident runbook reviewed and owners confirmed (SRE, Model, Product Ops, CS)
Minimum staffing roster confirmed for 48h post-launch with escalation contacts
Smoke tests across top 5 customer flows passing end-to-end
notes_to_reviewers: This sheet intentionally blends cost and reliability thresholds to force explicit tradeoffs during decisions
Propose a short drill with SRE + Model lead next week to validate thresholds and playbook timings
I borrowed the term 'attenuation index' from network congestion planning — it aggregates how many 'shock' vectors (latency, errors, quality, cost) the system can absorb before failing
